description: This file defines a React component called BrandsShop that displays products filtered by brand. It connects to Redux store to fetch product data and handles loading and empty states.

classes.name: BrandsShop
classes.description: A React component that displays products for a specific brand, fetching data on mount and update.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches products for the brand based on URL slug when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Refetches products if the URL slug changes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the product list, loading indicator, or not found message based on state.
